RENDERING: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no blur, no photographic texture. Flat cel shading, two or three tones per material (base, cooler greyer shadow, warmer highlight), one shadow shape per mass from a top-left light. Small controlled palette. Characters and enemies have a crisp 1-px black outline; floor tiles and wall faces have none. Grim humour, no gore, no blood. The room is a tall rectangle of white tiles with a dark chunky steel-grey wall border. The two sliding clinic doors that separate the zones sit on the room's vertical centre line, drawn as a gap in a horizontal wall segment with a steel door frame and a teal sliding door panel.
